name: R. D. Owen
mentions: …ay evening, given by Messrs. Keeler and Goodall. The music was furnished by Messrs. R. A. Dickinson and R. D. Owen, of Glendive, on violins, and T. J. Kerr on the piano. No one could possibly pick a flaw in the music and all three of the gentlemen showed that they were finished music…
